title: The passwd file must be present
checkText: Verify that the file /etc/passwd is present on the system.

title: The telnet client must not be installed
checkText: Verify the telnet package is not installed. Use rpm -q telnet; if it is installed, this is a finding.

title: The cramfs kernel module must not be loaded
checkText: Verify the cramfs kernel module is not loaded. Use lsmod | grep cramfs; if it is loaded, this is a finding.

title: SELinux must deny ptrace
checkText: Verify the SELinux boolean deny_ptrace is set to on with getsebool deny_ptrace. If it is off, this is a finding.

title: The default systemd target must be multi-user
checkText: Run systemctl get-default and verify the output is multi-user.target.

title: Wireless interfaces must not be configured
checkText: Verify that there are no wireless interfaces configured. This is N/A for systems without wireless network adapters. Check with nmcli device. If a wireless interface is configured and its use is not documented with the ISSO, this is a finding.

title: The SSH daemon must prevent remote proxy display connections
checkText: Check the SSH X11UseLocalhost setting with grep -i x11uselocalhost /etc/ssh/sshd_config. X11UseLocalhost yes. If the keyword is set to no, missing, or commented out, this is a finding.

title: The SSH banner must display the approved notice
checkText: Check Banner with grep -i banner /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Banner /etc/issue. If commented out, this is a finding. Then cat /etc/issue and verify it matches the Standard Mandatory DoD Notice and Consent Banner exactly: You are accessing a U.S. Government Information System. If the banner text does not match exactly, this is a finding.

title: SSH sessions must terminate after inactivity
checkText: Check ClientAliveInterval with grep -i clientalive /etc/ssh/sshd_config. ClientAliveInterval 600. If it does not exist, is greater than 600, or is commented out, this is a finding.

title: Windows must disable the lock screen slideshow
checkText: Set the registry value NoLockScreenSlideshow under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization to 1.

title: The Bluetooth service must be stopped
checkText: Use sc query bthserv. The Bluetooth Support Service must be stopped; if it is running, this is a finding.

title: The minimum password length must be 14
checkText: The Windows minimum password length must be 14 characters or greater. Verify the effective password policy.

title: Authorization Policy Change success auditing is required
checkText: Use AuditPol /get /category:* and verify Policy Change - Authorization Policy Change is Success. If it is not audited, this is a finding.

title: Files without a resolvable group must not exist
checkText: Run find / -xdev -nouser -print. If any files are returned without a resolvable owner, this is a finding.

title: Postfix restrictions must use the approved list
checkText: Run postconf -n smtpd_client_restrictions. The value may contain only reject_unknown_client_hostname and permit_mynetworks; anything else is a finding.

title: TFTP must operate in secure mode when installed
checkText: Verify whether tftp-server is installed with yum list installed tftp-server. If it is not installed, this is Not Applicable. If installed, grep server_args /etc/xinetd.d/tftp and verify server_args = -s /var/lib/tftpboot.

title: The system owner must approve the configuration
checkText: Review the supplied evidence with the ISSO and obtain documented system-owner approval. There is no command or objective technical predicate.

title: User initialization files must be owned correctly
checkText: For each local interactive user, inspect the user's home-directory initialization files and verify each file is owned by that user or root. If not, this is a finding.

title: All SSSD configuration fragments must use the approved setting
checkText: Check /etc/sssd/sssd.conf and every file in /etc/sssd/conf.d/*.conf. The ldap_id_use_start_tls setting must be true in every applicable file.

title: The proprietary agent must be configured securely
checkText: Verify the proprietary security agent is configured securely according to the vendor's current guidance. If not, this is a finding.

title: IPv4 forwarding must be disabled
checkText: Verify net.ipv4.ip_forward is set to 0 using sysctl net.ipv4.ip_forward. If the value is not 0, this is a finding.

title: The SSH private host key must not be group writable
checkText: Find SSH private host key files with find /etc/ssh -name 'ssh_host_*_key' -perm /g+w. Any result is a finding.

title: Remote login must be disabled
checkText: Run systemsetup -getremotelogin. The output must be Remote Login: Off; if it is On, this is a finding.

title: The system must use one approved authentication source
checkText: Verify either the approved local authentication configuration or the approved centralized authentication configuration is present. If neither is configured, this is a finding.

title: Local package signatures must be checked
checkText: Use grep localpkg_gpgcheck /etc/dnf/dnf.conf. The output must be localpkg_gpgcheck=1; otherwise this is a finding.

title: The home filesystem must use nodev
checkText: Run mount | grep /home and verify the /home filesystem includes the nodev option. If nodev is absent, this is a finding.

title: SSH private host keys must not be group writable
checkText: Find SSH private host key files with find /etc/ssh -type f -name 'ssh_host_*_key' -perm 0640. Verify the files are mode 0640 or less permissive; otherwise this is a finding.

title: Audit failure must halt or log
checkText: Run auditctl -s | grep -i failure. The failure action must be 1 or 2; if it is 0, this is a finding.

title: Network interfaces must not be promiscuous
checkText: Run ip link | grep -i promisc. If any interface is in promiscuous mode, this is a finding.

title: World-writable directories must be restricted
checkText: Find world-writable directories using find / -xdev -type d -perm -0002 -uid +999 -print. Any result is a finding.

title: The system must run a supported RHEL release
checkText: Run cat /etc/redhat-release. The result must identify Red Hat Enterprise Linux release 9; otherwise this is a finding.

title: The FTP server feature must not be installed
checkText: Use Get-WindowsFeature Web-Ftp-Service. If the feature is installed, this is a finding.

title: Unapproved AD users must not exist
checkText: Use Get-ADUser -Filter {Enabled -eq $true -and PasswordNeverExpires -eq $true}. Any returned account is a finding.

title: The security configuration file must be present
checkText: Verify the Windows file C:\Windows\System32\security.cfg is present.

title: The debug privilege must be restricted
checkText: The Debug programs user right must not be assigned to ordinary users. Review the User Rights Assignment and remove unapproved trustees.

title: Remote login must be disabled on macOS
checkText: Run systemsetup -getremotelogin. The output is Remote Login: Off. If it is On, this is a finding.

title: The sharing service must be disabled
checkText: Run launchctl print-disabled system. The output shows "com.apple.screensharing" => disabled.

title: The service account shell must be restricted
checkText: Run dscl . -read /Users/daemon UserShell. The output is UserShell: /usr/bin/false.

title: The insecure service must be disabled
checkText: Use svcs -a and inspect the service state. The legacy network service must be disabled; if online, this is a finding.

title: The insecure package must not be installed
checkText: Verify the telnet package is not installed with zypper search --installed-only telnet. If present, this is a finding.

title: The rsh client must not be installed
checkText: Verify the rsh-client package is not installed with dpkg -s rsh-client. If installed, this is a finding.

title: Direct root login must be restricted
checkText: Verify direct remote login to the root account is disabled. Check the root account shell and SSH configuration; if root login is permitted, this is a finding.

title: The organization must document an approved exception
checkText: If the control is not implemented, obtain an approved ISSO deviation and document the operational justification. No objective command or selector is provided.

title: The configured SSH banner file must contain the approved text
checkText: Run grep -i banner /etc/ssh/sshd_config to identify the Banner file, then read that dynamically selected file and compare the complete rendered login banner exactly.

title: All user startup files must be owned correctly
checkText: For each local user and every file matching /home/*/.[a-z]*, verify ownership and permissions. Any mismatch is a finding.

title: The cloud agent must use approved cryptography
checkText: Verify the cloud vendor agent uses the approved cryptographic configuration. Follow the vendor's current documentation; otherwise this is a finding.

title: Only one SSH banner directive must be effective
checkText: Check /etc/ssh/sshd_config for Banner /etc/issue. If duplicate or conflicting Banner directives exist, this is a finding.

title: The effective SSH client alive interval must be limited
checkText: Run sshd -T | grep -i clientaliveinterval and verify clientaliveinterval 600 or less. If the effective value exceeds 600, this is a finding.

title: No unauthorized accounts may be returned
checkText: Run awk -F: '$3 == 0 && $1 != "root" {print $1}' /etc/passwd. Any output is a finding.

title: Files without a resolvable group must not exist
checkText:
# find / -xdev -nogroup -print
If any files are returned without a resolvable group, this is a finding.

title: Postfix relay restrictions must be approved
checkText:
# postconf -n smtpd_client_restrictions
smtpd_client_restrictions = permit_mynetworks, reject_unknown_client_hostname
Only permit_mynetworks and reject_unknown_client_hostname are allowed; anything else is a finding.

title: The service configuration applies only when the service is installed
checkText: Determine whether postfix is installed with yum list installed postfix. If postfix is not installed, this is Not Applicable. If installed, run postconf -n smtpd_banner and verify the approved value.

title: The rendered login banner must be reviewed
checkText: Log in through SSH and visually verify that the complete approved banner is displayed before authentication. Record reviewer evidence.

title: The custom control must meet policy
checkText: Run /opt/vendor/bin/check-control --security and determine whether the proprietary result meets the policy. If not, this is a finding.
